Description: QR code generation for Umbraco Automate, powered by QRCoder. Generate a QR code for any value as part of an automation workflow, then save it to media or store the value on a property and preview it with the QR Code Viewer property editor.

Screenshots.Caption: Create a Data Type using the QR Code Viewer property editor
Configure the Generate QR Code action - value, output format, size, error correction, colors, and quiet zone
Bind Generate QR Code's output onto a QR Code Viewer property with Update Content Property
The QR Code Viewer property displaying a generated QR code on a content item
Render the QR code on the front end with the <qr-code> Tag Helper
Configure the Save QR Code to Media action to save the QR code as a Media item
Bind Save QR Code to Media's output onto a Media Picker property with Update Content Property
